summary: Cellectis S.A., a French foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its interim report for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026, comprising unaudited IAS 34 condensed consolidated financial statements and management discussion, incorporated by reference into its Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing timetable is disclosed; the filing maps to a US domestic issuer's quarterly report equivalent. Watch for financing or cash-runway commentary in the MD&A, but this is an ordinary periodic reporting event, not a special situation.
